title: Warm Spiced Indian Black Pudding Palak Paneer
description: A savory and light one-pot Indian dish featuring black pudding and paneer in a palak sauce, pescatarian-friendly and cooked to perfection in a papillote, this dish is a unique twist on traditional palak paneer.
instructions: Heat oil in a large pan over medium heat and add cumin seeds to sizzle.
Add chopped green chili, grated ginger, and minced garlic to the pan and saute until fragrant.
Add sliced black pudding to the pan and cook until browned on all sides.
Add cubed paneer to the pan and cook until it starts to brown.
Add spinach puree, garam masala, coriander powder, and paprika to the pan and stir well.
Season the mixture with salt to taste and stir well.
Create a papillote by placing the mixture in the center of a piece of parchment paper and folding the paper to create a packet.
Place the papillote in the pan, cover, and cook for 10 minutes or until the paneer is cooked through.
Serve the warm spiced Indian black pudding palak paneer hot, garnished with fresh cilantro if desired.
